text:
rachel: Quick announcement: Private/VPC installer v2.6 will ship with telemetry OFF by default for all NEW installs starting 2026-04-10 08:00 UTC. Not affecting Hosted API.

omar: Is this opt-in via console only or CLI too?

rachel: Both. We added `redwoodctl agent telemetry enable --tenant <ID>` and an in-console opt-in button. Docs page will include the consent flow example.

jen-legal: Legal thumbs-up pending minor edits. Include retention period (90 days) and explicit statement that request payloads are never collected unless customer opts in.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled: onprem-telemetry-default-rollout v2.6 at 2026-04-10 08:00 UTC. Change window: 20m. CI: https://ci.internal/build/77654

ops_lead: For existing customers: no silent switch. We will notify admins, leave current settings untouched for 60 days, and provide migration CLI.

rachel: Support impact: support bundles are still possible but redacted. To retrieve unredacted data, customer must approve temporary access via the consent UI. Runbook link created internally.

omar: Need brief GTM copy for sales. Could we get a one-liner?

rachel: I'll post a two-line blurb in #product-commms after legal finalizes wording.

jen-legal: Add console banner text: "Telemetry is OFF by default for new private installs. Enable to share anonymized metrics with Redwood to help improve reliability."

rachel: Action items: 1) publish KB for opt-in CLI and console, 2) send targeted customer email on deploy day, 3) add monitors for agent heartbeat + opt-in rates for first 72h.

deploy-bot: Runbooks created: docs/internal/onprem-telemetry-2-6-optin.md and docs/internal/onprem-telemetry-rollback-2-6.md

ops_lead: Will run staging smoke tonight.

rachel: Thanks everyone. Short sync tomorrow 09:30 PT for final sign-off.
